question: The Communist Party of India was formed in 1925 at the first Party Conference in _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kanpur **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Communist Party of India(CPI)** was formed in **Kanpur on 26 December 1925**.
 
• S. V. Ghate was the **first Secretary of CPI**.
 
• The **main participants who contributed **to the formation of the party were **workers, students, peasants and intellectuals**.
 
• **CPI **is the **oldest communist party **in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Communist conference** in which **CPI was formed was held at Kanpur in the same location at which the congress session was held**.
 
• The **Communist Conference **was **convened by Satya Bhakt**.
 
• **CPI **worked in close association with **Indian National Congress**.
 
• Many small political groups like the **Labour Kisan Party of Hindustan (LKPH) merged with CPI.**
 
• **On 6 February 1926 **at the conference in **Krishnanagar the name of the party changed to Workers and Peasants Party of Bengal**.
